name: Spacewalker
bio: Six hours outside the airlock without a scratch. Six seconds down here and somebody's shooting.
notes: New model 2026-11-26 (owner: the two astronaut uploads replace the three astronauts; the classic one is Spacewalker's; id, name and place kept).
